data.one_liner: Easily figure out detailed information about the platform your code is running on.
data.what_it_does: Platform Plus helps you detect specific platforms, operating system versions, web renderers, and device states such as whether the app runs on a physical device or in a unit test. It initializes asynchronously so that subsequent platform checks can be made synchronously.
use_when: You need to execute different logic for native versus web environments across various operating systems.
You need to check specific OS versions, web renderers, or if the app is running on a physical device.
You need to detect if your code is currently running within a unit test.
avoid_when: You only need standard Flutter web checks which can be handled using Flutter's built-in kIsWeb.
strengths: Comprehensive properties covering native vs web distinctions for major platforms.
Provides helpful device details like physical device detection, Android SDK versions, and iOS device types.
Supports web platform including web renderers and WASM.
weaknesses: Requires an asynchronous initialization step before calling platform property checks.
Fuchsia web support is currently unsupported.
data.setup_notes: Call PlatformPlus.platform.init() before accessing platform properties.

alternatives.name: universal_platform
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want a lightweight package specifically for checking platform types across web and native without additional device info or initialization requirements.
